subject: DR tabletop live-test: scheduling, sample transcript, and SIG/CAIQ artifacts
messages:
From: Lily Chen <lily.chen@clearstream.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: DR tabletop — can we run a live test and get SIG/CAIQ RTO artifacts?

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the call today. As we discussed with procurement and our security review team, ClearStream would like to: 

- Schedule a short live tabletop (30–45m) where your ops team demonstrates a warm failover scenario.
- Receive a short transcript or recording excerpt from a prior live test (what you typically show for SOC 2 / SIG reviewers).
- Get explicit artifacts that document RTO/RPO numbers for the hosted + dedicated deployment modes (we need these for the CAIQ / SIG mapping).

I've attached our latest questionnaire (Clearstream_SIG_Questionnaire_v3.pdf) with the specific fields the auditor will flag. If you can point us to the sample transcript and a short checklist you run for the warm-start, that would accelerate acceptance.

Proposed windows next week (our timezone PST):
- Tue 2026-10-06 09:00–09:45
- Wed 2026-10-07 14:00–14:45

Please confirm who from your side will be on the call and if you need any accounts or temporary access.

Best,
Lily Chen
Senior Security Program Manager
ClearStream Payments
(attachment: Clearstream_SIG_Questionnaire_v3.pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Lily Chen <lily.chen@clearstream.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DR tabletop — can we run a live test and get SIG/CAIQ RTO artifacts?

Hi Lily — thanks for sending the questionnaire. We can absolutely do this. Quick plan: 

1) Live tabletop: ops-led warm failover demo (30m) + 15m Q&A. I will run the intro and Marissa will handle the SOC 2 / SIG artifact walkthrough. Laura will join for the runbook steps and KV-cache warm verification.

2) Deliverables we’ll provide before the session:
   - A short 3–5 minute transcript + highlight clip from a recent warm failover (redwood_dr_playbook_snippet.pdf attached, excerpted logs and timestamps).
   - A one-page RTO / RPO table for Hosted / Dedicated deployments with the measured times and test dates.
   - SIG/CAIQ crosswalk notes for the RTO/RPO items.

3) Logistics: I’ve tentatively blocked Wed 2026-10-07 14:00 PST. I’ll send a calendar invite (livetest-invite.ics) and share a Drive folder for the sample artifacts.

Can you confirm the attendee list on your side and whether you want the session recorded and a redacted audio transcript?

Thanks — Jonas
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_dr_playbook_snippet.pdf; attachment: livetest-invite.ics)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lily Chen <lily.chen@clearstream.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DR tabletop — runbook & KV warm cache notes

Jonas / Marissa — looping in a couple of operational details to make the live demo crisp: 

- For the warm failover demo we will: drain traffic from primary pool -> activate standby pool prefetched KV cache -> re-route 10% traffic -> validate tail-latency and token-loss counters.
- Key verification artifact: kv-cache-warm-trace.txt (short extract showing cache-hit ramp, attached). Use this to show that the session state and pinned KV entries are available within the RTO window.
- Suggested screenshot: timeline from collector at +0s, +30s, +2m to show recovery progression.

Marissa: can you prepare the RTO/RPO table and the SIG mapping snippet? I can produce the log extracts and a short ops checklist we run live.

Laura Bennett
Director, Production Reliability
Redwood Inference
(attachment: kv-cache-warm-trace.txt)

Subject: Re: DR tabletop — scheduling, sample transcript, and SIG/CAIQ artifacts

Jonas / team — confirmed, thanks. Wed 2026-10-07 14:00 PST works for us. Attendees on our side: 
- Lily Chen (security)
- Aaron Patel (infrastructure lead) — devops@clearstream.com
- Priya Rao (auditor, third party) — joining as read-only

A couple of quick asks before the session: 
- Please include the short RTO/RPO table as a PDF in the shared Drive before EOD Monday (we need time to attach to the SIG questionnaire).
- We would like the session recorded and a redacted transcript; please redact any customer identifiers from logs.
- Can you mark in the RTO/RPO table whether the numbers are measured (test) or asserted (design)? Our auditors need that distinction clearly labeled.

Also — for evidence continuity — could you extract and provide the exact timestamps (UTC) used in the redwood_dr_playbook_snippet.pdf so we can reference them in the SIG questionnaire? That will help Priya map the timeline against other vendor evidence.

If you can get the Drive folder link and the quick artifacts to me by 2026-10-05 23:59 UTC, we’ll be able to proceed with our internal review. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Lily
Senior Security Program Manager
ClearStream Payments
